notes: Cut chart always errs slower - it rounded to the NEAREST charted thickness, so an 11.9mm plate took the 11mm row's speed instead of the 13mm row's, along with that row's current, process ID, torch heights and pierce time. It now picks the smallest charted thickness that still covers the plate; exact matches are unchanged. Highway J moves scale with the rapid speed instead of a hardcoded 100% - 600 mm/s stays 100%, 300 gives 50%, so one knob slows the linear rapids and these together. Manual functions (tip change, home, TCP calibrations, conveyor jogs) go straight to the robot's own inputs instead of PLC relay bits that no longer exist, which also cured a double-run; all are in the wiring dialogue. The Adjust dialog can set the ghost / stock length. New joint-reversal log for flat spots on small circles.
